text: Mila's dad passed away on Sunday. The funeral is at St Anne's on November 4. Remind me to send her a card before then.
Simone turns 40 on December 12th. She's been going on about a proper espresso machine for months, so that might be the gift.
Lars is completely obsessed with Warhammer at the moment. He's painting a whole Space Marine army and showed me photos of the tiny brushes he uses.
Talked to Tunde after the meeting. He was made redundant on Friday along with half his team. He's putting a brave face on it but he's clearly rattled. I should check in with him sometime next week.
Olivia and Rhys have split up. They'd been together six years. She's staying with her sister Ciara for now.
Need to pick up a birthday card for Mum and post it by 11/2 at the latest.
Bao supports Liverpool and has done since he was a kid. Season ticket holder, never misses a home game.
Layla's grandmother died last week. The funeral is in Lagos sometime early next month, so she'll be flying out and will miss the end of term.
Patrick is running the Chicago marathon on October 11. It's his first one and he admitted he's terrified about the last ten miles. Don't forget to text him good luck the night before.
Saanvi's birthday is May 14. Note for later: she loves anything to do with Studio Ghibli and collects the little Totoro figures.
Oscar's band has a gig at The Lexington on 11/21. I said I'd go, and I'm bringing Emil along too.
Spoke to Siddharth on the phone. His mum is having a hip replacement at the end of the month and he's going to stay with his parents for a couple of weeks afterwards to help out.

Shreya has got really into crochet. She's making a blanket for her niece, who is due to be born in early February, and wants to try amigurumi next. She showed me a little octopus she made from a YouTube tutorial. Her favourite yarn shop is closing down at the end of the month, so a gift card for somewhere else might be a good birthday idea.
Lior's wedding is off. He and his fiancée broke up in August, and he only told people this week. He seems okay, but quieter than usual.
Obi got his results back. He passed the bar exam! Remind me to take him out for a drink to celebrate.
Varun's dog Biscuit had to be put to sleep yesterday. He was fourteen. Varun was in pieces on the phone.
Anjali mentioned her son Varun starts secondary school in September and she's already stressing about the uniform list.

Graham told me all about his allotment while we waited for the bus. He's growing six kinds of chilli this year and is very proud of his Carolina Reapers, which he says nobody in the family will touch. He's entering the village show in late August and wants to win the produce category for once, after coming second three years running.
Agnieszka's mum is turning 70 on June 3rd and the whole family is flying to Kraków for the party. Agnieszka is organising most of it and sounds exhausted.
Book the car in for its MOT sometime next week. Also buy more printer ink.
Keisha mentioned she's been reading a lot of Terry Pratchett lately. She's halfway through the Discworld series and wants the next few for her birthday on 3/9.
Abigail was made redundant from the bank on Tuesday. Her last day is Friday the 31st. Need to ask her how the meeting with HR went.
Dmitri plays chess online most evenings and is rated about 1800. He's entering his first over-the-board tournament sometime in November and seems a bit nervous about it.
Bethany and her husband are celebrating their 25th anniversary on July 19. They're renewing their vows in the garden.
Jada told me her brother Bilal has moved back home after his breakup. Their mum is thrilled, Jada less so.
Ciara's cat Pickle went missing on Saturday. She's put posters up all over the estate. I should message her tomorrow to see if there's any news.
Laila has started learning the cello at 35. She practises every morning before work and has her first recital in early March.
Chris's uncle died on 10/14 after a long illness. He was close to him. The funeral is on Thursday and Chris is giving the eulogy, which he's dreading.
Rhys is a massive Cardiff City fan. Ask him how the match went at the weekend; he was too nervous to talk about it beforehand.
Emil and his girlfriend Valentina are expecting a baby in April. They only found out last month and are telling family over Christmas.

Mila said Simone has been really low since the layoffs at her agency. She lost her job two weeks ago and hasn't found anything yet. I'd like to take Simone for lunch at some point over the next couple of weeks, just to see how she's doing.
Quiet day. Finally finished the jigsaw.
Oscar's birthday is coming up on August 22nd. He's into vinyl, mostly old soul and Motown. A record voucher would go down well.
Siddharth plays cricket for the village second XI every Saturday over the summer. He's their wicketkeeper.
Remind me to call Lars on Sunday. His father's memorial service was yesterday and I couldn't make it.
Tunde's daughter Shreya is getting married on September 6. Tunde said the speech is keeping him up at night.
Layla just got into the regional women's football squad. She's been training for it since spring.
Graham's wife Abigail is in hospital again. He didn't say much, just that the doctors are running more tests this week.
Don't forget: Valentina's birthday is 4/27. She mentioned wanting a nice set of watercolour paints, the Winsor & Newton ones.
Bao's engagement party was supposed to be this Saturday, but they've called it off because his fiancée's grandad is unwell. They're hoping to rearrange for sometime in the new year.

Patrick builds model railways in his loft. He's spent about three years on a replica of the branch line near where he grew up, right down to the signal box and the little station café. His wife jokes that she's a railway widow. He mentioned he's after a particular Hornby locomotive, the green Flying Scotsman, which would make a great Christmas present from all of us.
Dentist on November 9 at 2:30. I'm leaving work early that day.

Saanvi was let go from the startup on Monday. She says she's fine and was half expecting it, but I'm not sure I believe her. She has a couple of interviews lined up sometime next week. Must remember to send her a good luck text before them, and then check how she's getting on afterwards.
Varun is into bouldering now. He goes three times a week and has started doing outdoor trips to the Peak District.
Anjali and her husband are hosting Diwali at theirs on November 8th. Everyone is bringing a dish; I said I'd do the samosas.
Obi's nickname at work is Obs, apparently. Obi Adeyemi, the new guy on the finance team, supports Arsenal and plays five-a-side on Wednesdays.
Agnieszka knits jumpers for her whole family every Christmas. This year she's starting early because she wants to do matching ones for the dogs.

Spoke to Keisha this afternoon. Her nan's funeral was on October 2 and it sounds like it was a lovely service. Her mum is struggling, though, and Keisha is staying with her through the end of the month. I need to send Keisha some flowers, and I should ask her when she's back if she wants to grab dinner.

Keisha's son Obi has his Grade 5 piano exam on 12/3. He's been practising scales every night and keeps saying he's going to fail, which he won't. Keisha says the sight-reading is what really scares him, so they've been doing ten minutes of it after dinner. I'll message Keisha that evening to find out how he got on.
Dmitri's sister is getting divorced. He mentioned it briefly; I don't think he wants to talk about it yet.

Bethany loves cold-water swimming. She's been doing it all year round at the lido, even through January, and swears it's the only thing that got her through her divorce. She's signed up for a sea swim around the pier on June 7 and her daughter Jada is coming down to watch. I should ask her afterwards how it went.
Pick up Jada's present before Friday. Her birthday is on the 25th and she's after the new Taylor Swift box set.
Bilal plays the oud and performs with a small group at weddings. He's been playing since he was about eight.

Ciara and Rhys broke up sometime over the summer. She's moved into a flat in Leith by herself and says she's honestly happier, though she admitted the evenings are hard. She's thinking of joining a book club or a climbing group to meet people. Remind me to invite her to the pub quiz on Thursday and to send her the details of Laila's book club.
Laila Kim told me her father is retiring from the hospital at the end of the year after 35 years as a surgeon. There's a big dinner for him in mid December. Remind me to ask her how it went.
Chris got a puppy! A border collie called Juno. She arrived on the weekend and has already chewed his trainers.
Mila's son Emil turns six on January 15th. He's mad about dinosaurs, especially anything with a T. rex on it.
Lior's grandad passed away on 9/30. I only heard today. I should give Lior a ring this evening.
Need to sort the spare room before the end of the month and book train tickets for Christmas sometime this week.
Emil was gutted after Saturday's match. His team lost the final 3-2 in extra time. I'll ask him about the rematch in early November.
